headline: Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited: General Updates
sum: General Updates - Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates: The Company has paid total consideration of Rs.32,32,97,915/- towards further acquisition, to maintain 26% Shareholding in Cleanmax…
detail: General Updates - Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates: The Company has paid total consideration of Rs.32,32,97,915/- towards further acquisition, to maintain 26% Shareholding in Cleanmax Sphere Energy Private Limited today i.e. on 11.06.2026. For more details kindly refer attached file.
